title: Woman Gets Arrested For Assault At Work After Being Fired
description:
On July 8th, 2023, officers responded to a battery. The caller advised that an employee who had just been terminated was acting in an agitated manner. She had pushed a chair towards another employee and had battered them. More backup arrived in order to assist the officers. She was soon transported to jail for further processing. One of the officers read her the Miranda rights. The woman was charged with resisting arrest, battery and aggravated battery upon a peace officer.
